terrains.name: Gentle hill
terrains.text: A gentle hill. Only the roundest will make it to the bottom.

terrains.name: Nearly flat
terrains.text: Barely a slope. Corners are now a death sentence.

terrains.name: Steep hill
terrains.text: A steep hill. Lumpy things can tumble down too. Evolution relaxes a bit.

terrains.name: Cliff
terrains.text: A cliff. Everything rolls. Squares thrive. Evolution has given up.

milestones.text: Something rolled 5 metres! The others watched, jealous.
Halfway down the hill! The blobs are learning that corners hurt.
A shape reached the bottom of the hill! Its children will inherit the slope.
The best shape is now 90% round. Evolution is onto something.
Evolution has reinvented the wheel. A caveman did it in an afternoon, but sure.

meteor: ☄️ A meteor wipes out the top half of the population. The survivors are mostly potatoes.
☄️ Mass extinction! The fittest are gone. Somewhere, a very lumpy blob inherits the earth.
☄️ BOOM. Natural selection has been replaced by unnatural selection.
design: 🙌 You place a perfect circle among them. Intelligent design detected. Darwin is spinning (like a wheel).
🙌 A perfect circle descends from the heavens. The scientists among the blobs are furious.
pointy: 💘 Pointy is now attractive. Blobs with corners get more dates. Rolling becomes secondary.
💘 Sexual selection now favors spikes. This is going to end in stars.
